mapper.update: /*selectMasterWmStAssmblDirectionsCreationPopBomQty*/ UPDATE WMSSTCK SET PRE_GR_QTY = PRE_GR_QTY+#{ASSEMBLY_QTY} WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND STDCATLG_ID =#{BUYER_ITEM_NO} AND AGENT = 'KRKORE0001'

/*selectMasterWmStAssmblDirectionsCreationPopSubQty*/
UPDATE WMSSTCK ST SET AVAIL_QTY = NVL(AVAIL_QTY,0)-(SELECT QTY*#{ASSEMBLY_QTY} FROM KEPBOFM WHERE BOM_ID = #{BUYER_ITEM_NO} AND SUB_ID = ST.STDCATLG_ID AND STATUS <> 'D'), ALLOC_QTY = NVL(ALLOC_QTY,0)+(SELECT QTY*#{ASSEMBLY_QTY} FROM KEPBOFM WHERE BOM_ID =#{BUYER_ITEM_NO} AND SUB_ID = ST.STDCATLG_ID AND STATUS <> 'D'), CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_USER = #{st_user_id} WHERE (WAREHOUSE_CODE, STDCATLG_ID, AGENT) IN ( SELECT ST.WAREHOUSE_CODE, STDCATLG_ID, ST.AGENT FROM WMSSTCK ST, KEPBOFM BOM WHERE ST.STDCATLG_ID = BOM.SUB_ID AND ST.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND BOM.BOM_ID = #{BUYER_ITEM_NO} AND ST.PROCESS_TYPE = '1' AND ST.AGENT = 'KRKORE0001' AND ST.STATUS <> 'D' )

/*updateMasterWmStAssmblDirectionsCreationPop*/ UPDATE icomsqmt SET year = decode(year,to_char(sysdate,'yyyy'), year, to_char(sysdate,'yyyy')) , cur_no = decode(year,to_char(sysdate,'yyyy'),cur_no+1,1) WHERE company ='KRKORE0001' and doc_type='AS'
mapper.select: /*selectMasterWmStAssmblDirectionsCreationPopORDERNO*/ Select doc_type||SUBSTR(year,3,2)||LPAD(cur_no,6,0) AS_NO FROM Icomsqmt WHERE company='KRKORE0001' and doc_type='AS'

#{st_sel_item_no}
